quote.summary: Adaspace Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company principally engaged in the provision of satellite and related services and satellite-based solutions. Satellite and related services business focuses on the design, manufacturing, launch coordination with third-party launch service providers and post-launch telemetry, tracking and command services of satellites, including artificial intelligence (AI) application satellites and AI computing satellites. Satellite-based solutions business focuses on transforming satellite data into practical solutions for customers across a wide range of application scenarios. The Company is also involved in sales of satellite structural components, satellites materials, components and models for research and educational purposes, and satellite-related branding and naming services. The Company’s other services primarily include intelligent parking solutions and software and hardware agency services.
